root.label: Los Angeles Times reports California low-income housing costs

events.label: Los Angeles Times reports California low-income housing costs

slots.name: California unit cost
slots.sentence: Los Angeles Times reporters in 2020 revealed that the cost of some low-income housing units in California had grown to more than $1 million each

slots.name: families without homes
slots.sentence: The Times found that 12,000 more low-income families could have received homes between 2011 and 2015 had costs been as low as they were elsewhere.
